meta_title: Natural Touch Gardening | Garden Services Birmingham
meta_description: Natural Touch Gardening in Birmingham offers expert garden design, maintenance, and landscaping. Local family business serving Bournville and beyond. Call today.
hero_subhead: Overgrown beds and patchy lawn? We transform tired gardens into outdoor spaces you'll actually use and enjoy.
services_subhead: From routine lawn care to full garden redesigns, we handle every aspect of outdoor maintenance and landscaping.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Bespoke garden plans that match your style and budget. We source materials, manage the build, and deliver a space built to last.

services.title: Lawn Care & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular mowing, aeration, seeding, and weed control keep your grass healthy and green year-round. Monthly or seasonal packages available.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Tree Work
services.desc: Safe removal, shaping, and seasonal pruning of hedges and trees. We dispose of all waste responsibly and leave your garden looking sharp.

services.title: Planting & Flower Beds
services.desc: Professional planting of perennials, annuals, and shrubs. We choose plants suited to your soil and sunlight, then maintain them through the seasons.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Tidy-Up
services.desc: Overgrown jungle? We clear, tidy, and haul away all waste. Perfect for new homes, rental properties, or a fresh start.

services.title: Patio & Pathway Installation
services.desc: Quality hard landscaping using natural stone or block paving. We prepare, level, and finish to professional standards with long-lasting results.

about_pullquote: I started this business because good gardeners were hard to find and harder to trust.
about_para_1: Natural Touch Gardening was founded in 2009 by Mark Henderson, a lifelong gardener frustrated by unreliable contractors and cowboys charging over the odds. Over 15 years, we've built a loyal following across Birmingham and Solihull by turning up on time, doing honest work, and treating every garden—however small—with genuine care.
about_para_2: Our repeat customer rate speaks for itself. Homeowners return year after year because we listen to what they want, explain our work clearly, and never upsell unnecessary work. We're local, we're rooted here, and we take pride in the gardens we touch.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Mark came out and completely transformed our back garden. It was a real mess—overgrown beds, dodgy paving—and I wasn't sure where to start. He gave us a free design consultation, quoted fair, and got the job done in three weeks. Really pleased with the result and his team were tidy and professional throughout.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Been using Natural Touch for lawn care every month for two years now. The grass looks better than it ever has, and they're reliable—always turn up when they say they will. Mark even gave us advice on drainage when we had standing water. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Susan K.

reviews.text: After my mum passed away, the garden had gone to pot. I rang Mark expecting a massive bill, but he was honest about what needed doing and kept costs sensible. They cleared everything, replanted some perennials, and the garden is now a peaceful space. Top bloke.
reviews.author: James R.

address_sub: Serving Bournville, Harborne, Solihull, and across greater Birmingham

footer_description: Natural Touch Gardening is a local, trusted gardening business in Birmingham. We offer garden design, maintenance, and landscaping backed by 15+ years of honest work.
